## Failing tests

- TestHintBarFollowsTheCursorRow: on a decision row the hint bar lists enter and the global keys; on an awaiting-approval engine row it adds a and x; on a paused row t; in an open pane esc and pgup/pgdown; on the Roadmap l. It never lists a key the row refuses.
- TestEnterOnDecisionOpensItsOptions: enter on a decision row opens a pane with the record's title, each option label and summary, and the recommendation with its reasoning; esc closes it.
- TestEnterOnHeldItemOpensRoadmapDetail: enter on a held row switches to that project's Roadmap and opens the item's detail.
- TestNumberKeysFollowTheSidebar: 1-9 select the first nine projects in the sidebar's drawn order, the sidebar shows those numbers, and 0 selects Needs you.
- TestFirstAndLastRowKeys: g and home go to the first row, G and end to the last.
- TestPageKeysMoveRowsWithoutAPane: with no pane open, pgdown and pgup move the cursor by the body height; with a pane open they still scroll the pane.
- TestGroupJumpKeys: } moves to the first row of the next group, { to the first row of the current or previous group.
- The answer field keeps owning typing keys: g, G, 0 and { typed into an answer go into the text.
